name: Felsőmarác (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, red at the hoist and white at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőmarác (a red shield with a white figure, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the name FELSŐMARÁC.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Felsőmarác arms with helm, crest and mantling
